product_overview: A public-facing dental clinic website that helps visitors learn about the clinic, browse services and doctors, view galleries and case studies, and book appointments or send inquiries. It also includes an administrative dashboard for managing bookings and messages.
core_goals: Learn about the clinic, its services, and its dental specialists
Browse clinic photos and clinical before-after examples
Book an appointment by selecting treatment, doctor, date, and time
Send a contact inquiry or feedback message
Manage appointments and inquiries through an admin dashboard

features.name: Public Clinic Information Pages
features.description: Visitors can review the clinic’s homepage, about information, services, doctors, and FAQs to understand offerings and staff.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review facility summary and dentist profile summaries -> Navigate to /about -> Review clinical services and facility details -> Navigate to /services -> Review treatment categories -> Navigate to /doctors -> Review dentist roster -> Navigate to /faq -> Search for a question -> Expand an answer category

features.name: Gallery Browsing with Filters and Lightbox
features.description: Visitors can explore clinic images by category and open photos in a larger view for closer inspection.
user_flows: Navigate to /gallery -> View the full image gallery -> Select a category filter -> Review the filtered photo cards -> Hover over a photo card -> Observe the image description overlay -> Open a photo in the lightbox -> Dismiss the lightbox

features.name: Before-and-After Case Study Viewing
features.description: Visitors can browse clinical case studies and use them to begin an appointment booking flow with prefilled context.
user_flows: Navigate to /before-after -> Review clinical case study cards -> Open a case study -> Trigger booking with case context -> Continue to the booking workflow

features.name: Appointment Booking Wizard
features.description: Patients can complete a multi-step appointment request by choosing a treatment, selecting a doctor, picking a date and time, and entering contact details.
user_flows: Navigate to /book -> Select a dental treatment category -> Select an assigned doctor -> Choose a date from the calendar picker -> Choose an available timeslot -> Fill in contact details and notes -> Submit the booking request
Navigate to /book -> Select a treatment category -> Leave required contact details incomplete -> Attempt to submit the booking request -> See validation feedback

features.name: Contact Inquiry Form
features.description: Visitors can send questions or feedback directly to the clinic through a public contact form.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in name, email, phone, and message -> Submit the message -> See confirmation of submission
Navigate to /contact -> Leave required fields incomplete -> Submit the message -> See validation feedback

features.name: Newsletter Subscription
features.description: Visitors can subscribe to the clinic newsletter using the email signup in the site footer.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter an email address in the footer subscription form -> Submit the subscription request -> See confirmation of signup
Navigate to / -> Enter an invalid email address in the footer subscription form -> Submit the subscription request -> See validation feedback

features.name: Clinic Administration Console
features.description: Administrators can review bookings and messages, filter records, update appointment status, delete entries, and toggle simulated action mode in the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Switch between dashboard panels -> Open a sub-panel -> Search for a record -> Confirm or cancel an appointment -> Delete a booking, subscriber, or message -> Review the updated list
Navigate to /admin -> Open Settings -> Toggle simulated action mode -> Return to the management panels

routes.description: Homepage showing facility summary and dentist profile summaries
About page detailing clinical services and Navrangpura facility details
Offerings page listing clinic dental treatment categories
Specialists roster page listing all dentists
Interactive gallery with category filtering and visual lightbox
FAQ page with accordion categories and live filter search bar
Before-after clinical case studies with direct book-prefill triggers
Contact form to submit messages and feedback
Administrative dashboard to manage bookings, messages, and configurations

features.name: Appointment Booking Wizard
user_interactions: Select a dental treatment category
Select an assigned doctor
Choose a date from the calendar picker
Choose an available timeslot button
Fill in contact details (name, email, phone, notes)
Click Submit Booking button

features.name: Clinic Administration Console
features.description: Managing appointments, message inquiries, settings, and subscribers
user_interactions: Click sidebar tabs to switch panels
Click sub-tab buttons on top panel
Enter query string in search bar to filter
Click Confirm or Cancel buttons on appointments
Click Delete icon button to remove appointments, subscribers, or messages
Toggle simulated action mode checkbox in Settings

features.name: Gallery Category Filters & Lightbox
features.description: Dynamic clinic photo display with category pills and lightbox popups
user_interactions: Click category filter buttons (All, Clinic, Tech, Team)
Hover over image cards to view overlay description details
Click a photo card to trigger full-screen lightbox modal view
Click cross button to dismiss lightbox modal

features.name: Contact Inquiry Form
features.description: Public submission of contact inquiries and feedback message notes
user_interactions: Fill name, email, phone, and message input fields
Click Send Message button to submit

features.name: Newsletter Subscription Form
features.description: Footer email signup for clinical newsletter subscription campaigns
user_interactions: Fill in email input inside the footer newsletter container
Click Subscribe button

known_limitations.issue: Doctors, Services, Blog Posts, and Testimonials editing in the admin panel are UI-only
known_limitations.impact: Roster edits, treatment additions, article statuses, and reviews moderation are saved locally in component state and do not persist across database round-trips.
